> One ecosystem. One doctrine. One source of truth. Many interfaces.

Version 1.0.0, reviewed 2026-11-17. Machine-readable: [https://standards.bundu.org/ecosystem.jsonld](https://standards.bundu.org/ecosystem.jsonld).

## The Foundation

**Bundu Foundation** (Zimbabwe Company Limited by Guarantee). The umbrella of the ecosystem. It governs the four pillars, holds their intellectual property, and publishes the ecosystem's open standards. Bundu is Shona for wilderness.

## The four pillars

| Pillar            | Role                                               | Audience                                                                                                                                              | Built and sold by                             |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| **Bundu Labs**    | Research, knowledge, standards and frameworks      | Researchers, standards bodies, educators, the public                                                                                                  | —                                             |
| **Nyuchi Africa** | Platform and infrastructure                        | Developers and businesses building digital services; micro and small businesses and informal traders; governments and institutions that extend access | —                                             |
| **Mukoko**        | The consumer pillar                                | Individuals, families and communities                                                                                                                 | built by Nyuchi Africa, sold by Nyuchi Africa |
| **Shamwari AI**   | Community-facing AI and conversational experiences | Communities and individuals, in Shona, Ndebele and English                                                                                            | built by Nyuchi Africa, sold by Nyuchi Africa |

- **Bundu Labs.** The research and standards arm of the Bundu Foundation. It investigates infrastructure gaps across Africa and emerging markets, and publishes the standards, frameworks and vocabulary the rest of the ecosystem builds on.
- **Nyuchi Africa.** The platform and infrastructure company of the ecosystem: the Nyuchi API, the console, and its own tools and products. Nyuchi builds and sells Mukoko and Shamwari AI, and builds Mzizi. It builds platforms others build on; it is not an outsourced IT department or a managed service provider.
- **Mukoko.** One consumer platform with its apps inside, as Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace hold theirs: a super app, with apps that also stand alone in their own domains. Built and sold by Nyuchi, on the Nyuchi API.
- **Shamwari AI.** An African AI companion that answers in Shona, Ndebele and English and cites its sources. A pillar and a Bundu Foundation open-source project; it runs on Nyuchi's AI layer and is sold by Nyuchi.

## Shared foundations

Foundations enable and connect the pillars. They are not pillars.

| Foundation          | Role                                                | Owner            | Status    |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------- |
| **Ubuntu**          | The ethical and engineering doctrine                | Bundu Foundation | Canonical |
| **Mzizi**           | Shared design system and implementation foundations | Bundu Foundation | Live      |
| **.cell**           | The data store for one entity, stored in SiafuDB    | Bundu Foundation | Proposed  |
| **Nyuchi API**      | The common API and infrastructure                   | Nyuchi Africa    | Live      |
| **Bundu standards** | Data architecture and interoperability standards    | Bundu Labs       | Live      |

## The seven engineering constraints

Defined, with their Ubuntu principles and checks, in Mzizi (`get_doctrine`). By id:

1. `outdoor-readability`
2. `connectivity-gradient-design`: Offline-first is its enforced minimum, not a separate constraint.
3. `multilingual-parity`
4. `shared-device-awareness`
5. `personal-data-sovereignty`
6. `no-surveillance-business-model`
7. `bundu-floor`

## Terms

| Term                                     | Status         | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Platform tokens (MIT, MXT, NST, NHC)** | Proposed       | A proposed Mukoko project and a future build-out, not on the current roadmap (owner, 2026-11-17). Four tokens are proposed: MIT (identity, soulbound) and MXT (exchange) for Mukoko, NST and NHC for the Nyuchi Honeycomb. Not in development, none issued, none on sale. Never described as live, scheduled or governed today. |
| **Nyuchi Honeycomb**                     | In development | The distributed, decentralised platform Nyuchi is building. Like a honeycomb, it holds cells: each person's data lives in their own pod. In development; never described as live.                                                                                                                                               |
| **Pod**                                  | In development | A person's own store of data in the Nyuchi Honeycomb, made of cells. Today personal data lives on the device and syncs with cloud storage already isolated per person, so the move to pods is a simple migration.                                                                                                               |
| **Mukoko apps**                          | Canonical      | The apps inside the Mukoko platform, available in the super app and standalone in their own domains. Nhimbe, bushtrade, lingo and the other single-purpose brands are Mukoko apps.                                                                                                                                              |
| **Frontier infrastructure**              | Canonical      | Infrastructure engineered for places where bandwidth, devices and budgets are constrained, held to the seven engineering constraints.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **Pricing principle**                    | Canonical      | Consumption is predominantly free. No forced upgrades, artificial usage limits or constant upselling. Commercial value comes from API consumption, integrations, partnerships, platform adoption, embedded services and data products, never from excluding the people the ecosystem exists to serve.                           |

Never use: "Web3" (say pod, Nyuchi Honeycomb); "sister brand" (say Mukoko app); "IT support" (say platform and infrastructure).
